en.prefs.keep_unsaved_in_browser: Keep unsaved work in this browser instead of asking when the tab closes
en.prefs.keep_unsaved_in_browser_tip: Each open design's unsaved changes are kept up to date in this browser's private storage. The next visit offers to restore them.
en.recovery.restore_intro: Changes that weren't saved when this page last closed are kept in this browser.

ar.prefs.keep_unsaved_in_browser: الاحتفاظ بالعمل غير المحفوظ في هذا المتصفح بدلاً من السؤال عند إغلاق علامة التبويب

he.prefs.keep_unsaved_in_browser: לשמור עבודה שלא נשמרה בדפדפן זה במקום לשאול כשהכרטיסייה נסגרת
